# Morning Briefing  

## Immediate Priorities  
- **ICLR ablation sweep (rewrite vs. append)** – *deadline:* day 19 (rebuttal).  
  *Use MemGPT virtual‑context paging as the naive‑append baseline (conf = 0.78).*  
  **Action:** schedule 4‑6 H100 runs; monitor GPU usage (< 2400 h).  
- **Weekly lab meeting** – *at 11 :00 Wednesdays* (previous Thursday slot dropped).  
  **Action:** add a 15‑min update on ablation progress in agenda.  

## Open Hypothesis Ledger Items (high confidence)  
| # | Insight | Action | Deadline |
|---|---------|--------|----------|
| 8 | Add periodic consolidation step to isolate rewrite gain (conf 0.66) | Implement consolidation routine & run a pilot sweep | Day 15 |
| 10 | Use Thursday lab slot to brief team on ablation progress (conf 0.64) | Add brief to Thursday agenda (14:00, room 311) | Today |
| 13 | Integrate periodic consolidation into Structured Memory Rewrite to reduce cross‑fact interference (conf 0.65) | Build consolidated‑memory module; test on validation set | Day 18 |
| 23 | Deploy MemGPT paging to capture weekly lab notes as real‑world test (conf 0.64) | Prototype script; schedule run post‑meeting | Day 20 |

*All items fit within the 2400 H100 GPU‑hour monthly quota.*

## Drafted Reply  
**To Reviewer 2:**  
> “We will conduct a rewrite‑vs‑append ablation, using MemGPT’s virtual‐context paging as a naive‑append baseline, and additionally report results with a periodic consolidation step that reduces cross‑fact interference. Results will be completed before the rebuttal deadline.”  
*Draft: ready for copy‑edit.*  

## Nudge  
*Lab meeting shift:* Remember the weekly lab meeting now starts Wednesday 11 :00 instead of Thursday 14:00 – update calendar invites accordingly.  

## Overnight Idea  
**“Overnight idea:”**  
Running the rewrite‑vs‑append sweep alongside the periodic consolidation experiment should not only satisfy reviewer 2 but also expose a clear performance differential that can be highlighted in the paper’s ablation section.
